name: Song Jiang
rationale: Kind-hearted county clerk who shelters fugitives; every outlaw trusts his word.

name: Lu Junyi
joinTrigger: After Chao Gai dies at Zengtou and Wu Yong lures him north-bound to Liangshan's snare
rationale: Wealthy Daming master of the staff and spear, the only man the marsh chiefs fear in open combat.

name: Wu Yong
rationale: Village schoolmaster who plans the birthday-convoy robbery and every later ruse.

name: Gongsun Sheng
rationale: Daoist who calls wind and fog; the marsh's weather-worker.

name: Guan Sheng
joinTrigger: After Liangshan besieges Daming and Cai Jing sends Guan Sheng to relieve it
rationale: Upright descendant-in-spirit of the red-faced general; wields a crescent blade on horseback.

name: Lin Chong
rationale: Arms instructor of the imperial guard, framed by Gao Qiu's household over his wife.

name: Qin Ming
rationale: Hot-tempered Qingzhou commander with a spiked mace; easily provoked into rash charges.

name: Huyan Zhuo
joinTrigger: After Gao Qiu names Huyan Zhuo to crush Liangshan with chain-linked cavalry
rationale: Descendant of a founding general who fights with two steel whips and linked horse.

name: Hua Rong
rationale: Deputy commander of Qingfeng Fort whose arrows never miss; shelters Song Jiang.

name: Chai Jin
rationale: Descendant of the former dynasty with an iron-clad charter; open-handed host to every exile.

name: Li Ying
rationale: Master of the Li Family Village with flying knives; ally of the Zhu clan until the feud.

name: Zhu Tong
rationale: Yuncheng constable with a famous beard who twice lets prisoners go.

name: Lu Zhishen
rationale: Frontier officer who kills a butcher to save a girl and hides in a monastery; staff-wielding giant.

name: Wu Song
rationale: Tiger-killing constable who takes bloody revenge for his brother.

name: Dong Ping
joinTrigger: After Song Jiang demands grain from Dongping Fu and its commander Dong Ping is drawn out
rationale: Dongping garrison commander, brilliant with two spears and careless about honour.

name: Zhang Qing
joinTrigger: After Dong Ping falls and Liangshan turns on Dongchang
rationale: Dongchang cavalry captain who throws stones with deadly aim.

name: Yang Zhi
rationale: Disgraced officer who sells his ancestral blade in the capital and kills a bully.

name: Xu Ning
joinTrigger: After Tang Long steals his armour and lures him south with a forged story
rationale: Imperial guard instructor who teaches the hooked-spear drill and owns a famous mail coat.

name: Suo Chao
rationale: Daming vanguard with a heavy axe who charges first and thinks later.

name: Dai Zong
rationale: Jiangzhou jail superintendent who can run hundreds of li a day with charmed leg-wraps.

name: Liu Tang
rationale: Roving ruffian with a red birthmark who brings the news of the birthday convoy.

name: Li Kui
rationale: Jiangzhou jailer who swings twin axes, kills tigers, and obeys only Song Jiang.

name: Shi Jin
rationale: Young village headman with dragon tattoos who trained under a disgraced master.

name: Mu Hong
rationale: Landowner of Jieyang who rules the town's ferries with his brother.

name: Lei Heng
rationale: Yuncheng constable and former smith, fast on his feet.

name: Li Jun
rationale: Salt-smuggling river captain who leads his own band of boatmen.

name: Ruan Xiaoer
rationale: Oldest of three fishing brothers who know every channel of the marsh.

name: Zhang Heng
rationale: Ferryman who robs midstream passengers and throws them overboard.

name: Ruan Xiaowu
rationale: Middle Ruan brother, a reckless swimmer and gambler.

name: Zhang Shun
rationale: Fish broker who can stay under water for hours; the finest swimmer of the hundred and eight.

name: Ruan Xiaoqi
rationale: Youngest Ruan, blunt and fearless, mocks officials and fights best afloat.

name: Yang Xiong
rationale: Executioner and jail officer of Ji prefecture, dutiful until his wife betrays him.

name: Shi Xiu
rationale: Wood seller who sworn-brothers Yang Xiong and exposes his wife's affair.

name: Xie Zhen
rationale: Hunter whose tiger is stolen by a rich neighbour.

name: Xie Bao
rationale: Xie Zhen's brother, a trap-setter and a steel-fork fighter.

name: Yan Qing
joinTrigger: After Lu Junyi falls to Liangshan's plot and is jailed at Daming
rationale: Lu Junyi's servant; a wrestler, archer, singer and quick-witted go-between.

name: Zhu Wu
rationale: Chief of Mount Shaohua; quiet planner who reads the battlefield.

name: Huang Xin
rationale: Qingzhou garrison officer who boasts he can crush three mountain camps.

name: Sun Li
rationale: Dengzhou garrison commander with a steel whip and a mighty bow arm.

name: Xuan Zan
joinTrigger: After Guan Sheng is sent against Liangshan and Xuan Zan accompanies him
rationale: Ugly-faced imperial son-in-law who still leads a heavy cavalry blade.

name: Hao Siwen
joinTrigger: After Guan Sheng is sent against Liangshan and Hao Siwen is captured beside him
rationale: Guan Sheng's sworn brother, steady fighter and loyal friend.

name: Han Tao
joinTrigger: After Gao Qiu sends Huyan Zhuo and gathers the Chenzhou and Yingzhou troops
rationale: Chenzhou army commander with a long lance.

name: Peng Qi
joinTrigger: After Gao Qiu sends Huyan Zhuo and gathers the Chenzhou and Yingzhou troops
rationale: Yingzhou commander wielding a three-pointed blade, who joins the campaign against the marsh.

name: Shan Tinggui
joinTrigger: After Song Jiang marches on Lingzhou in the campaign against the Zeng clan's allies
rationale: Lingzhou garrison commander who uses water-based tactics.

name: Wei Dingguo
joinTrigger: After Song Jiang marches on Lingzhou in the campaign against the Zeng clan's allies
rationale: Lingzhou commander whose fire-throwing troops scorch enemy lines.

name: Xiao Rang
rationale: Jizhou scholar who can copy any hand and seal.

name: Pei Xuan
rationale: Incorruptible legal clerk who judges on the evidence.

name: Ou Peng
rationale: Huangmen Mountain chief, once a frontier soldier.

name: Deng Fei
rationale: Xiangyang brawler with a chain-and-iron weapon and flashing eyes.

name: Yan Shun
rationale: Leader of the Qingfeng Mountain band.

name: Yang Lin
rationale: Wandering fighter who joins friends at Mount Mangdang.

name: Ling Zhen
joinTrigger: After Huyan Zhuo is defeated and Ling Zhen, the imperial gunner, is captured
rationale: Imperial cannoneer who builds powder-fired thunder engines.

name: Jiang Jing
rationale: Failed examination candidate who turns merchant, then bookkeeper.

name: Lyu Fang
rationale: Duiying Mountain chief with a halberd, a Lü Bu admirer.

name: Guo Sheng
rationale: Duiying Mountain chief with a halberd, rival of Lü Fang.

name: An Daoquan
joinTrigger: After Song Jiang falls ill with a malignant abscess and no marsh healer can help
rationale: Jiankang physician of imperial fame, kept from the marsh by his own comforts.

name: Huangfu Duan
joinTrigger: After Liangshan's war horses sicken and need a veterinary expert
rationale: Northern horse doctor with a purple beard.

name: Wang Ying
rationale: Lecherous short bandit of Qingfeng Mountain; fierce but unreliable.

name: Hu Sanniang
rationale: Daughter of the Hu Family Village, expert with twin blades and a red lasso.

name: Bao Xu
rationale: Dead-Tree Mountain chief, short-tempered and given to killing travellers.

name: Fan Rui
rationale: Mangdang Mountain wizard-bandit who commands storm spirits.

name: Kong Ming
rationale: Qingzhou estate heir, headstrong with a spear.

name: Kong Liang
rationale: Kong Ming's younger brother, impetuous.

name: Xiang Chong
rationale: Mangdang Mountain chief with a shield bristling with knives.

name: Li Gun
rationale: Mangdang Mountain chief with a shield and flying spears.

name: Jin Dajian
rationale: Seal carver who forges stamped documents.

name: Ma Lin
rationale: Huangmen Mountain chief, a flute-playing swordsman.

name: Tong Wei
rationale: Salt-boat smuggler, brother of Tong Meng.

name: Tong Meng
rationale: Salt-boat smuggler, brother of Tong Wei.

name: Meng Kang
rationale: Shipwright who knows how to build towering river barges.

name: Hou Jian
rationale: Tailor who can climb and sew banners and clothes.

name: Chen Da
rationale: Mount Shaohua chief, foolhardy rider.

name: Yang Chun
rationale: Mount Shaohua chief with a long blade.

name: Zheng Tianshou
rationale: Qingfeng Mountain bandit with delicate looks.

name: Tao Zongwang
rationale: Farmhand turned digger, handy with a spade and earthworks.

name: Song Qing
rationale: Song Jiang's younger brother, a careful farmer and cook.

name: Yue He
rationale: Dengzhou jailer, singer and linguist, quick with languages.

name: Gong Wang
joinTrigger: After Dong Ping falls and Liangshan turns on Dongchang
rationale: Dongchang lancer with a tiger tattoo on his neck.

name: Ding Desun
joinTrigger: After Dong Ping falls and Liangshan turns on Dongchang
rationale: Dongchang lancer with flying spears.

name: Mu Chun
rationale: Mu Hong's younger brother, a minor local bully.

name: Cao Zheng
rationale: Butcher turned innkeeper, a pupil of Lin Chong.

name: Song Wan
rationale: Liangshan's early lieutenant under Wang Lun.

name: Du Qian
rationale: One of Liangshan's founding bandits, a loyal subordinate.

name: Xue Yong
rationale: Wandering medicine seller who performs spear displays.

name: Shi En
rationale: Son of the Mengzhou prison warden who runs the Happy Forest racket; a brawler by training.

name: Li Zhong
rationale: Wandering performer and medicine seller who stumbles into the story early.

name: Zhou Tong
rationale: Mount Taohua chieftain, bully and would-be groom.

name: Tang Long
joinTrigger: After Wu Yong needs a smith who knows the hooked-spear secret
rationale: Master blacksmith, son of a famous weaponsmith.

name: Du Xing
rationale: Steward of the Li household who turns up in Ji prefecture on his master's business.

name: Zou Yuan
rationale: Dengyun Mountain chief, uncle of Zou Run.

name: Zou Run
rationale: Zou Yuan's nephew, strong-headed.

name: Zhu Gui
rationale: Liangshan's lookout innkeeper who watches the marsh road.

name: Zhu Fu
rationale: Zhu Gui's younger brother, tavern keeper.

name: Cai Fu
joinTrigger: After Lu Junyi falls to Liangshan's plot and is jailed at Daming
rationale: Daming executioner who sells his services.

name: Cai Qing
joinTrigger: After Lu Junyi falls to Liangshan's plot and is jailed at Daming
rationale: Cai Fu's brother, flower-wearing executioner.

name: Li Li
rationale: Tavern keeper who drugs travellers on the Yangtze road.

name: Li Yun
rationale: Yishui constable, a friend of Li Kui.

name: Jiao Ting
rationale: Wrestler of Zhongshan, rude and rough-handed.

name: Shi Yong
rationale: Gambler and wandering fighter of Daming.

name: Sun Xin
rationale: Dengzhou tavern keeper, brother-in-law of Xie Zhen.

name: Gu Dasao
rationale: Tavern keeper's wife, a spirited fighter.

name: Zhang Qing
rationale: Ten-Foot Slope innkeeper and gardener.

name: Sun Erniang
rationale: Zhang Qing's wife, runs a notorious inn.

name: Wang Dingliu
joinTrigger: After Zhang Shun is sent to fetch An Daoquan from Jiankang
rationale: Jiankang tavern keeper and fast messenger.

name: Yu Baosi
rationale: Tall roadside bandit; the novel gives little detail.

name: Bai Sheng
rationale: Gambler and petty thief caught in the birthday-convoy affair.

name: Shi Qian
rationale: Rooftop thief and tomb-raider; breaks into any house.

name: Duan Jingzhu
joinTrigger: After he steals the Zeng fortress's famous white charger
rationale: Northern horse thief.
